analysis_view.channel_policy: existing FFmpeg mono downmix; may cancel antiphase content

chroma_definition.tuning_policy: global candidate offset when available; otherwise declared A440

harmony_analysis.score_semantics: cosine similarity of L2-normalized vectors; not probability or calibrated correctness

global_key.reason: Requires at least eight active frames and four pitch classes at >=0.06 share

local_keys.reason: Requires at least eight active frames and four pitch classes at >=0.06 share

limitations: Spectral peaks can be harmonics, percussion or mixture artifacts; no separated notes or instrument identities.
Limited equal-tempered Western chord/mode vocabulary; excluded chords and non-tonal music are not absent.
A one-second centered FFT blurs changes; a 250ms grid is not chord-onset accuracy.
Tuning is a global modulo-semitone candidate; key weights are declared heuristics, not learned or perceptually qualified profiles.
Bass peaks are low spectral components, not verified bass notes; competing inversions can be wrong.
Mono downmix can cancel phase-opposed sources; content above2kHz does not contribute.
Candidate absence, high scores and small margins do not establish musical truth.
